summary: Cottonwood Communities, Inc. (CCI), a Maryland REIT, filed an 8-K reporting an October 15, 2026 amendment to a series of merger agreements originally signed September 2, 2026 with entities controlled by Barry R. Mandel, under which CCI would indirectly acquire all interests in a multifamily residential portfolio. The amendment corrects a scrivener's error in the escrow calculation, now set at 1.5% of purchase price inclusive of assumed or repaid debt, split between cash escrow and restricted CROP Units subject to clawback, released one year post-closing. Concurrently, CROP and guarantors entered a $75 million JPMorgan term loan on October 16, 2026, partially funding the transaction. Consideration mix, per-asset pricing and closing timing remain undisclosed in the excerpt; watch debt funding, escrow clawback claims and eventual portfolio valuation disclosure.
